name: LALAL.AI Video Stem Splitter
summary: LALAL.AI uses AI to extract vocals and music from video files, making it easy to remix or edit soundtracks for new projects.
description:
LALAL.AI uses AI to extract vocals and music from video files, making it easy to remix or edit soundtracks for new projects.

Audio stem extraction: Precisely separate vocals, instrumentation, drums, and other elements from video or audio files. Batch processing: Upload and process multiple video files at once for efficient workflows. High-accuracy AI: Maintains excellent sound quality and clarity during the extraction process. Multi-format support: Works with a wide range of video and audio file types for maximum flexibility.

howToUse.title: Sign Up or Start for Free
howToUse.description: Go to LALAL.AI and either sign up or start the free trial to access the stem splitter tool.

howToUse.title: Upload Your Video or Audio File
howToUse.description: Drag and drop or select the file you want to split. LALAL.AI supports MP4, MP3, WAV, and many other formats.

howToUse.title: Choose Stems to Extract
howToUse.description: Select which stems you want—vocals, instrumental, drums, bass, etc. LALAL.AI will process accordingly.

howToUse.title: Processing & Preview
howToUse.description: Wait for the AI to analyze and separate the tracks. You can preview the extracted stems before downloading.

howToUse.title: Download Stems
howToUse.description: Download your separated audio files and use them for remixing, editing, or any new creative project.

howToUse.title: Batch Mode (Optional)
howToUse.description: For large jobs, use batch processing to split stems from multiple files in one session (requires paid plan).
